scripts.title: Asylum UnBlurred
scripts.script:
-- Disable Blur Forever
-- This code was generated by Cobalt
-- https://github.com/notpoiu/cobalt

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Remove existing blur
if Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur") then
	Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur"):Destroy()
end

-- Continuously prevent blur from being applied
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	-- Remove any blur effect that tries to appear
	if Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur") then
		Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur"):Destroy()
	end
end)

-- Also prevent the remote from working by intercepting it
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
pcall(function()
	local Event = ReplicatedStorage.Remote.UpdateBlur
	
	-- Disconnect all existing connections
	if Event.OnClientEvent then
		Event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(BlurAmount)
			-- Block the blur from being applied
			if Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur") then
				Lighting:FindFirstChild("Blur"):Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end)

print("Blur disabled permanently!")

scripts.title: Aimbot Right M button
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local smoothness = 0.15      
local fovRadius = 250      -- This shit is for Fov Changing, SKIDDD
local maxDistance = 500

local isAiming = false
-- the creating shit uk
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AimbotFOV"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local fovCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
fovCircle.Name = "FOVCircle"
fovCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, fovRadius * 2, 0, fovRadius * 2)
fovCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -fovRadius, 0.5, -fovRadius)
fovCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fovCircle.BorderSizePixel = 0
fovCircle.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
corner.Parent = fovCircle

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 100)   -- color from the circle
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Transparency = 0.35
stroke.Parent = fovCircle

-- the dot in the center
local centerDot = Instance.new("Frame")
centerDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
centerDot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0.5, -3)
centerDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 100)
centerDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
centerDot.Parent = fovCircle

local dotCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
dotCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
dotCorner.Parent = centerDot

-- this here is to get the player in the fov like the circle
local function getClosestPlayer()
	local closestPlayer = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge
	local screenCenter = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= player and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			local humanoid = p.Character.Humanoid
			if humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head then
					local headPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
					
					if onScreen then
						local distanceFromCenter = (Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
						
						if distanceFromCenter <= fovRadius then
							local distance = (head.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
							if distance < shortestDistance and distance <= maxDistance then
								shortestDistance = distance
								closestPlayer = p
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	return closestPlayer
end

-- Input normal stuff
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		isAiming = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		isAiming = false
	end
end)

-- Main things
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not isAiming then return end
	
	local target = getClosestPlayer()
	
	if target and target.Character then
		local head = target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then
			local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, head.Position)
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, smoothness)
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Zaxy Suite V1
scripts.features:
🌟 Zaxy Suite v1 — by Zaxy.Hex
Script universal com interface Rayfield, compatível com mobile. BETA TESTE.
O que tem:
🎯 Hitbox Expander — expande o HumanoidRootPart dos players, com controle de tamanho, transparência e cor
👁️ ESP completo — box, skeleton, tracer, barra de HP e highlight. Detecta time automaticamente (Infectado/Normal) e muda a cor
⚡ Speed — controle de WalkSpeed com slider
💾 Config — salva, recarrega e reseta suas configurações
🔗 Discord: discord.gg/WudTSxveBc
🎮 Roblox: @KHVVKUB
🎵 TikTok: @Zaxy.Hex
